prompt: A garage scene with mechanics and vehicles. A mechanic is working under a car on a lift, tightening bolts with a wrench while wearing coveralls. Another mechanic is changing a tire on a motorcycle, using a tire iron while kneeling beside the bike. The mechanic working on the car is noticeably taller than the mechanic kneeling by the motorcycle. A customer is standing next to the service counter, signing papers while pointing at his keys hanging on a hook. The service advisor is explaining the repair bill to the customer while holding a clipboard. Behind the counter, there are four screwdrivers and a set of wrenches organized on a pegboard; the number of wrenches is two more than the number of screwdrivers. An apprentice is sweeping the floor with a broom, collecting oil stains and debris. The apprentice is younger than both mechanics. A tow truck is parked outside the garage, with its crane arm extended over a broken-down vehicle. The tow truck is an older model, showing more wear and tear than the sleek, modern car on the lift. On a workbench, there are two gas cans and a group of funnels; the number of funnels is one more than the number of gas cans.
